card.name: "Other" in drug-effect table titles
card.fires_on: The word "Other" right after "effect(s) of [drug] on" or "affecting" in drug interaction table headings. It also fires weakly on "to" or "and" in choice or comparison phrases.

modes.label: Other drugs heading
